_readme: One table for the two readers of a changed-target refusal: is_target_changed_text (src-tauri/src/providers/types.rs) and isTargetChangedRefusal (src/utils/targetChanged.ts). A case is the rendered error and whether it is the refusal. The position of the marker decides: where the text starts or behind wrappers only. The two rows whose text opens with a relative path named after the marker are read as the refusal on purpose: no path is taken out of the text, so a file named after the refusal's own first words cannot remove them.
